content: There are many possible ways to implement the idea of improving question answering with external KB. In this work, we use external KBs (such as NELL and ProBase) to enhance the representations of elements in the document KB. For instance, the argument “the sequence of amino acids” in Figure 1 from the document KB retrieves (“amino acids”, `is”, “protein”) from NELL. Enhanced with this additional clue, the original argument is a better match to the question.
